_comment: Locked baseline for tests/mira_bench.py. Update when an intentional regression-or-improvement lands and is reviewed. See .github/workflows/mira-benchmark-weekly.yml and scripts/check_benchmark_regression.py.

thresholds._doc: Re-pinned from the REAL product (staging /api/quickstart/ask/, median of 3) with the v3 answer key. The v2 numbers (282 vs 255) were a harness stand-in graded by an older judge against a key copied from a wrong seed, and are not comparable. mira_total_min = 164 - 10 (~6% judge variance). mira_advantage_min = -39 - 12: the product currently TRAILS the plain LLM (refuses 4/10 questions with 'no manuals in the public knowledge base'; GS10 seed #4031 feeds wrong registers). This gate only catches backsliding; raise both floors as #4031 and the refusals are fixed.
